title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 8
body: He is polite in public and different in private. Perfect with your parents, rude to the guard. He holds the door for you and shouts at the traffic warden. Watch him when he thinks nobody important is looking. That is the man you will be living with.
caption:
Send this to the friend who defends him.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 8
body: Her photos take forty attempts. You are the photographer, the lighting guy and the assistant. "It looks bad, take it again" for one hour. Then she posts the first one. The first one was fine. The first one was always fine. You just lost an hour of your life.
caption:
Tag the friend who says it's fine.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 8
body: They compare you to the neighbour's daughter, the cousin's friend and the earlier girl who was "almost perfect." "She was taller but you have a better degree." You are being judged by a committee that never told you the rubric. Add "a thick skin" to your biodata.
caption:
Send this to someone with a rishta meeting this week.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 8
body: The maybe zone is addictive because maybe feels like hope. A clear no hurts for a week. A maybe hurts for years. Which one would you choose if you were choosing for a friend? Choose the same for yourself. The week of pain is cheaper than the year of waiting.
caption:
Send this to the friend still waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 8
body: He tells you everyone's secrets. Who is dating whom, who cheated, who is broke. He narrates his friends like a news anchor. A man who tells you everyone's secrets on date one will tell everyone yours on date two. Smile, nod, and share nothing.
caption:
Which one happened to you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 8
body: "Phone died." He posted a story two minutes ago. "Network issue." He is on a video call. "Family function." He has had eleven cousins marry this month. Nobody is too busy for someone they like. People are busy with you only when it is convenient.
caption:
Screenshot this and send it to your group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 8
body: You help her choose outfits for dates with other men. Your taste is excellent and your odds are zero. You have been at the dress rehearsal and never the show. You carry her shopping bags to her happiness, and the happiness has a different name.
caption:
Tag the friend who is everyone's free therapist.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 8
body: His phone is always face down. Notifications off. Airplane mode when you are around. A faithful man's phone is boring. His phone is a hostage situation. He takes it to the washroom, to the kitchen and to the balcony. Nobody has this much privacy for a weather app.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs this before the weekend.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 8
body: Do not look at his posts. Look at the tagged photos. That is where the truth lives. A trip in 2021 with friends who are wearing matching rings. A birthday cake with a name you have never heard. A hug that is two seconds too long. The internet remembers.
caption:
Check his tagged photos before you reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 8
body: Stop saying "he changed for her." He did not change. His timing did. Same excuses, new passenger. Everyone pretends it was personality when it was calendar. If you want to be angry, be angry at the calendar. The calendar has been unfair to all of us.
caption:
Tag the friend whose ex got engaged in two months.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 8
body: The committee meets only at weddings. The agenda: your marriage. Aunties exchange phone numbers and a "wait and see." You came for biryani and left with a rishta and three prayers. By the time you reach home, someone has already sent your photo to a cousin.
caption:
Tag someone whose rishta is stuck in committee.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 8
body: "I'm setting a boundary" means he is cancelling. "I need space" means he does not want to make plans. His boundaries only go one way. He has boundaries for you and none for himself. He needs alone time, but only when it is your birthday. Funny how that works.
caption:
Tag the friend who asked your moon sign on the first date.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 8
body: "Not interested in dowry." On the next page: "gifts as per capacity." The capacity turns out to be a car, a flat and twenty four carat gold. "We want nothing" is a very long list of nothing. Read slowly. The small print is where the shopping list lives.
caption:
Send this to a girl who has read a rishta profile.
